SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN U.Age > 65 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(P.Id) AS ElderUserPercentage
FROM posts P
JOIN users U ON P.OwnerUserId = U.Id
WHERE P.Score > 5
